(rule!
  ;; alt: find each diagonal red 2x2, then paint its two zero corners green.
  (let* ((windows
          (filter
            (lambda (p)
              (let* ((r (first p))
                     (c (second p))
                     (a (at g r c))
                     (b (at g r (+ c 1)))
                     (d (at g (+ r 1) c))
                     (e (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1))))
                (or (and (= a 2) (= e 2) (zero? b) (zero? d))
                    (and (= b 2) (= d 2) (zero? a) (zero? e)))))
            (for*/list ([r (range 0 (- h 1))]
                        [c (range 0 (- w 1))])
              (list r c))))
         (inside-window?
          (lambda (p)
            (any? (lambda (q)
                    (and (>= (first p) (first q))
                         (<= (first p) (+ (first q) 1))
                         (>= (second p) (second q))
                         (<= (second p) (+ (second q) 1))))
                  windows)))
         (missing
          (filter (lambda (p)
                    (and (zero? (at g (first p) (second p)))
                         (inside-window? p)))
                  (grid-positions g))))
    (paint-cells g missing 3)))
